notes: Derived from the 0x32c04 spec with EAX left random (the stub loads the F8 key name). Synthetic preset/track tables with random padding and key names (mixed case, duplicates, junk). Key-name pointers use the game's own F1..SF10 string table. The view loader 0x2fbc4 (file I/O, error hook) is replaced in both runs by a synthetic stub that records EAX at 0x1e2000 and returns 0x1234abcd.
